name: SpectroCoin Card
summary: SpectroCoin Card is a Visa prepaid card from Lithuania supporting BTC, ETH and other cryptos. Free card issuance and shipping with €25,000 daily POS limit. Up to 99 virtual cards per account.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the SpectroCoin Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$1.15 per month. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the SpectroCoin Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 3% on non-base-currency spending.
